answer: Kiln time at a hilltop zenith oven is not sold to a crowd of extra nametags. A potter claims one firing slot by presenting a single lotus-stamped clay coupon whose wet mass at 21°C is 18.40 to 18.60 grams, then holding a 90-second ember pyrometer dwell whose peak stays between 912 and 918°C. A second coupon, a mass miss past 0.08 grams, or a reused stamp serial burns the 31.2 POA bond and cools that oven for five firings.
